about: A story's foes (doc 86, C10): how strong each kind is, read by the game for foe.add and foe.outlaw. skill is the fighting skill, strength the body's, hp how much a blow is worth against them (20 is an ordinary bandit's: a blow does 20/hp of its damage), flee the health (0-100) under which they run. Tuned by foe_sim against the bar of engine-spec C10t.
followerLook: Hard-faced and armed, at their leader's back.
